cells.gaps: No source found reports Burundian payments running on PAPSS: the BRB has acceded and authorised four banks (August 2026), with no live participation reported.
cells.note: The BRB launched BurundiPay in April 2026, a national instant payment system linking banks, microfinance and payment institutions. Its PAPSS accession with four banks authorised reports no live participation, which the study does not count as taking part.
